note: The most a part 14 program may ask of Java Arena's practice JavaFX at once, as a guard on the engine's speed: a canvas with more drawing calls than the library keeps (5250, each with a color of its own; the first 5000 are kept), a WritableImage of 512 x 512 (the biggest whose pixels the window JSON carries) and a line chart whose 1000 points are added one by one and then moved along one by one (remove the first, add one). The browser run must take at most maxRunMs (12 s, under the 15 s limit of a JavaFX run on the site; about 4.5 s on a desktop): writing a call or an image's pixels into the window JSON, or checking a series for a point added twice, that grew slow again would fail it.
